atlas_fit.current_problem: Atlas needs local retrieval that connects Markdown facts across files while preserving source identity and freshness.
atlas_fit.future_risk: LLM-extracted graph edges and embeddings may create false relationships or silently drift after model changes.

claims.claim: The repository documents a local Markdown Graph RAG system with wikilink/frontmatter parsing, hybrid retrieval, incremental updates, Ollama processing, and storage-integrity checks.
Its extracted graph and anti-hallucination prompt make every answer factually reliable.

excluded_classes: raw financial, legal, tax, insurance, mortgage, estate, brokerage, or account evidence
